name: mint-safe-mac-storage
description: Inspect Mac and AI-tool storage, with journaled Trash-only cleanup through Mint.
long_description: Mint is an on-device macOS storage intelligence and file-operation safety layer. This extension connects Claude Desktop to the MCP server built into Mint Direct so Claude can explain disk growth, review what Codex, Claude, Cursor, and other AI tools keep on the Mac, scan reclaimable space, review recent activity, and perform narrowly scoped cleanup through Mint's operation journal. Cleanup is Trash-only, protected paths are refused, and eligible actions can be undone in Mint while the underlying item remains in Trash. Requires macOS 14 or later and Mint Direct 1.0.25 or later.

tools.name: mint_status
tools.description: Get disk trends, recent activity, and managed-folder status.

tools.name: mint_why
tools.description: Explain storage growth or recorded operations involving a path.

tools.name: mint_scan
tools.description: Scan developer caches, app caches, logs, and junk for reclaimable space.

tools.name: mint_agents
tools.description: Review AI-tool storage, conversation state and age, and compressible archived Codex media from Mint's latest scan.

tools.name: mint_recent
tools.description: Review recent journaled file operations and their classification reasons.

tools.name: mint_activity
tools.description: Review recent Mint activity, including moves, cleanups, scans, and errors.

tools.name: mint_rules
tools.description: List cleanup rules and templates or dry-run a rule without changing files.

tools.name: mint_execute
tools.description: Move eligible items to Trash through Mint's journal and return a recovery reference.
